structured_output.summary: This was a duplication finding, so it needed no red/green test. In tests/content/hay-loop.test.ts (tonight's new file) I added `import { headingOf, wrapAngle } from '../../src/sim/vec.ts';`. The heading helper now returns `headingOf(bx - ax, bz - az)` in place of the inline `Math.atan2(bx - ax, -(bz - az))`. The turn delta now uses `wrapAngle(d)` in place of `Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d))`. Both helpers compute the same values over (−π, π], so the test behaves as before and the copied maths is gone. `pnpm typecheck` passes, and `pnpm test` passes all 82 files and 622 tests, including the Hay Loop suite.
